name: Mu
about: Mu is Zei's mentor in Dzego and a commander in the Kungaupei defense society. The book calls her an older woman but gives no other detail, so this look is invented and contributors are welcome to replace it.

facts.quote: An older woman noticed him and turned to him.
an older woman about the same age as Mu
facts.fact: Confirms Mu is an older woman.

facts.quote: Mu raised the glass. "To our future," she said.
facts.fact: She/her; mentor to Zei and Bai.

facts.quote: jackets covered in a mixture of white and grey
facts.fact: Wears a white-and-grey jacket in the snow.

facts.quote: Mu gently whispered, patting the robot on its head and taking her tea
facts.fact: Gentle with the robots; drinks tea.

facts.quote: Mu had immediately taken over as the commander of Group South.

descriptor: a woman in her early sixties, small and wiry, medium brown skin, short silver hair in a sharp asymmetric cut, keen eyes behind thin red-framed glasses, wearing a tailored charcoal tech vest with bright yellow piping over a long-sleeved cobalt-blue top, slim black trousers and soft grey shoes
